reviews.name: Isabel O.
reviews.text: Mel is amazing at what she does! She completes her services with careful precision, makes sure you're comfortable (even to speak freely), and knows how to achieve the exact look you ask for. She's amazing, definitely will be returning for more.

reviews.name: Caroline S.
reviews.text: Mel L LOVEEEE coming here. Such a peaceful environment and she always does an amazing job. The retention is by far the best.

reviews.name: Kaylee
reviews.text: Mel was amazing and so sweet from the moment I walked in. My lashes turned out absolutely amazing.

reviews.name: Darcie
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience getting a Korean lash lift! From the start, she provided exceptional customer service by reaching out to let me know about a cancellation, which allowed me to move my appointment up to an earlier time. During the appointment, she took the time to thoroughly explain the differences between a Korean lash lift and a traditional lash lift. My lashes came out absolutely amazing! They look beautifully lifted, natural, and exactly what I was hoping for.

reviews.name: Leila
reviews.text: An absolute artist and lovely soul

reviews_note: Isabel, Caroline S. y Kaylee fueron provistas y verificadas en la tarea (Isabel se re-confirmo verbatim casi identico en el JSON-LD de Booksy, con apellido abreviado 'O.' y fecha 2026-07-08). Darcie y Leila son 2 resenas adicionales reales encontradas en el JSON-LD (Review schema) embebido en la pagina de Booksy, no estaban en la lista original.

brand_vibe.description: Logo oficial de Booksy: wordmark script 'WildChild' en verde oliva oscuro sobre fondo crema calido, con un pequeno icono de hoja/pluma. Fotos del feed muestran estetica limpia, calida, natural (sin neon ni oscuridad dramatica); una foto de negocio ('biz_photo') muestra un letrero de neon dorado 'WildChild' sobre fondo de estudio con motivo de utensilios de lash. Conclusion: marca clara/crema, calida, botanica-editorial, NO oscura.
